# logging

## Overview
Logging utilities (Logger, Logging) for Analysis Server communications.

## Interface
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.logging.Logger
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.logging.Logging

## Invariants
- Formats and routes log entries.

## Side Effects
- Logs messages.
